name: slack_charlie_amend_request_dates
use_case: Pick up a leave question from Slack and reply in the thread after approval
branch: The US HR business partner asks the desk to apply Charlie Brown's date correction for REQ-1103 from his Slack thread, where he corrected the dates twice; the latest correction governs.
tests: Reads the whole Slack thread, takes Charlie's latest correction (22 to 24 December, not the earlier 23 to 24), and amends REQ-1103 to those dates.
instruction:
